scope: Independently authored fake ACP process and synthetic protocol cases; no live conversation captures
constraints: No imports from proxy implementation packages
fixture/* methods are synthetic test controls, not Kiro capabilities
Prepared-launch markers and alias manifests are invented fixture controls, not copied Kiro configuration or effective restriction evidence
All text, error strings, IDs and credential sentinels are synthetic
Descendant processes only exercise lifecycle cleanup; they execute no client tool
The chat-tools-separate-group mode deliberately creates an MCP child in a distinct process group for the independent cooperative group-join experiment
The chat-tools-stopped-idle mode stops only its own relay PID after a synthetic result, testing bounded cleanup failure and process retirement without a client tool effect
Effort command shapes remain specification interpretations under D09; the separate read-only tools inventory uses the observed D39 envelope with independently authored data

Inventory modes accept only initialization, one session/new and one advertised argument-free tools query; optional MCP readiness must match the owned session and exact serverName; no model prompt or tool effect is supported

MCP tool requests are answered by synthetic test clients or an opt-in unmodified public client with an independently authored denying hook; the fake backend performs no filesystem or shell tool effect
